segments.text: Page 82, conversation. Listen and read, then say
Helen, would you like to go mountain climbing with me?
To tell you the truth, I prefer going to the beach and collecting seashells.
That's fine with me. When would you like to go?
I would like to go right now while the beach is less occupied.
Okay. Mom and Sarah are coming with us. Sarah loves playing in the sand.
Make sure you put on lots of sunscreen. We don't want anyone to get a sunburn.
Look at the beach. You were right, Helen, there aren't many people here at this time.
Look at the seashells. I'm going to collect dozens of them.
I want seashells, too. I'll help you pick them up.
Sarah, stay close to us.
I love surfing in the ocean. Do you wanna go surfing with me?
Sure. Sarah, stay with Mom so she can keep an eye on you.
Okay, Stella. I don't mind waiting for you. I love building sandcastles.
I'm so glad that the beach is close by.
Me too. I like walking to the beach. A car is not even necessary to get here.
So did you find a surfboard yet?
There are lots of them over there. Let's go and rent two of them.
Have fun.
We will. Come on, Helen, let's surf
